title: Refine Lighthouse Puzzle: Mouse Steering, [F] Key Interaction, Ground Pedestal and Top-Lantern Beam
description: Refine the twin lighthouse light-refraction puzzle in PlayScene2 based on playtest feedback: change beam steering to horizontal mouse movement, change item pickup and socketing to [F] key, ground the steering wheel and socket pedestals firmly at foot level under the lighthouse, and emit the light beams from the very top of the lighthouse lantern room.
acceptance_criteria: Player can pick up and socket items (Ignition Crank and Ancient Prism) using [F] key.
Steering wheel and socket pedestals are positioned on the ground/island floor beside the lighthouse entrance (y ~ 1.3m - 1.7m), with no mid-air floating elements.
Light beams emit from the high lantern room at the top of the lighthouses (y > 8m), angling dynamically across the marsh.
Rotating mouse horizontally while controlling the turn wheel steers the lighthouse beam angle smoothly.
LevelTwoValidation passes cleanly with the new input mapping and top-lantern emitter positions.
test_command: Unity Editor MenuItem: 'Hold My Hand/Level 2/Wire Beacons Watermill and Victory'
risks: Ensure mouse delta sensitivity is calibrated so steering feels responsive without jitter.
Ensure top lantern raycast ignores lighthouse body geometry when shooting downwards.
